title: fix(plugin-grid): name the grouped grid’s own pager buttons, and census icon-only Buttons (objectui#12143)
body:
Fixes #12143

Clause-②: no

A grouped `ObjectGrid` with more than one page of groups draws its own pager, `groupedPager`, not the `data-table` one PR objectui#12142 named. Its first / previous / next / last controls were four `Button variant="outline" size="icon"` whose only child was a chevron, so a screen reader announced four unnamed buttons. Each now carries `aria-label={t('table.KEY')}` read through the grid's own `useGridTranslation`, which `groupedPager` already used for `table.rowsPerPage` / `table.pageInfo`. No literal English, and no pack key added.

| Button | Key | en | zh |
|---|---|---|---|
| first | `table.firstPage` | First page | 第一页 |
| previous | `table.previousPage` | Previous page | 上一页 |
| next | `table.nextPage` | Next page | 下一页 |
| last | `table.lastPage` | Last page | 最后一页 |

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: four `aria-label` attributes on `groupedPager`'s buttons, and four `GRID_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` rows, byte-identical to the `en` pack, for a host with no `I18nProvider`. Nothing else in the file moves.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupedPagination.test.tsx`: the "advances to the next page" and "shows the last (partial) page" cases reach their button by role and name (`en.table.nextPage` / `en.table.lastPage`) instead of by its place among the four.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupedPagerNames-12143.test.tsx` (new pin): a grouped grid with 12 groups over pages of 5. Each of the four is found by role and name and driven to the page of groups it names (first, last, previous, next), with no provider (the `en` pack's words) and under `zh` (the `zh` pack's words, and none of the English ones). A click must land where the name says, so two swapped keys are red too.
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/iconOnlyButtonCensus-12143.test.ts` (new census, below).
- `.changeset/12143-grouped-pager-names.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## The census: icon-only `Button`s with no name

Triage `6109778067` asked for an enumeration pin on the family's third member (objectui#11690, objectui#12124, this card): a test in the ordinary suite, not a new CI gate.

- **Where it lives.** `packages/components`, because that package owns the `Button` it judges. The sibling census objectui#12145 landed lives in `packages/i18n` for the same reason: that package owns the packs its remedy reads. The two families stay separate, as triage says.
- **Population.** Every source file under a `packages/*` workspace's `src/` tree, minus tests and tooling (the `TOOLING` shape the objectui#12145 census reads). `apps/*` is outside it, because triage scoped it to `packages/*/src`.
- **What it judges.** It reads the TypeScript AST, so comments and strings are never a site. A JSX `Button` element is icon-only when, apart from whitespace, its one child is an icon element, or a `{cond ? A : B}` toggle whose every branch is one. An icon element's tag is either imported from `lucide-react` in that file (aliases and namespace imports count) or ends in `Icon`. The button is named when it carries `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or `title`. An `sr-only` span would be a second child, so a button that has one is not icon-only. A tooltip is not a name.
- **What it cannot see.** These are stated in its header: a name passed through a spread, an icon that arrives as a value (`{icon}`), a native `button` element, and whether a name is translated (that question belongs to objectui#12145).
- **Ratchet.** `BACKLOG` freezes each unnamed one by file and icon, keyed by content and not by line. Declared and found must agree exactly: a new unnamed button turns the census red, and a button that gets a name must leave the list in the same commit, so the count can only fall. The `DetailView.tsx` `recordNavigation` previous/next pair is in the backlog, as triage ruled, and is not part of this fix.
- **Controls.** Width guards cover the packages, files, Buttons and icon-only Buttons it reads. A lit control checks that the `data-table` pager and `groupedPager` are each read as four named icon-only chevrons. An in-memory fixture shows that each shape it judges is counted and each shape it does not judge is not.

**Readings at two shas.** These are dated measurements, not live counts. The census re-derives them: on failure it lists every site with its line.

- BASE `c0c2f79` (before the fix): **35** unnamed icon-only `Button`s in 20 files. That includes `groupedPager`'s four.
- HEAD `08a3765`: **31** in 19 files. The four `ObjectGrid.tsx` chevrons are gone, and nothing else changed.

## Reverse verification (run from committed `08a3765`)

Script with `trap restore EXIT INT TERM`. The restore is `git checkout HEAD -- ABSOLUTE_PATH`, proved by the disk blob equalling the HEAD blob and by an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **Leg A: `ObjectGrid.tsx` back to BASE** (`git checkout c0c2f79 -- …`). The mutation landed: on-disk `aria-label={t('table.*Page')}` count went 4 to 0 and defaults rows 4 to 0, and the disk blob `354a18c1` equals the BASE blob. Result: `Tests 6 failed | 7 passed (13)`.
  - Census red with exactly the four `groupedPager` buttons: `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx · ChevronLeft / ChevronRight / ChevronsLeft / ChevronsRight — frozen 0, found 1` (the census prints each site's line, left out here per AGENTS.md #11). Its lit control is also red.
  - Both `groupedPagerNames-12143` cases are red.
  - The two moved `groupedPagination` cases are red.
  - Restored: blob `4e241b4f` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Leg B: keep the labels, drop only the four defaults rows.** This used objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode (anchor hit once, blob changed, restore proved by the tool). Result: `Tests 3 failed | 10 passed (13)`. The no-provider name walk and the two moved `groupedPagination` cases are red. The `zh` case and the census stay green, because there the pack answers and the attribute is present. So both halves of the fix are load-bearing.

## Local verification (HEAD `08a3765`)

- ① `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-grid^...' --concurrency=2` (verify lock): `Tasks: 13 successful, 13 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- ② `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` (both script names echoed): `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `--listFilesOnly` on each `tsconfig.test.json` shows that the census and both plugin-grid test files are compiled.
- ② Targeted vitest (repo-root form, 12 files): the census, the new pin, `groupedPagination`, `ObjectGrid.groupedPagerSelect-11865`, `serverGrouping-7189`, `pagerButtonNames-12124`, `footerSummaryScope-12081`, `ObjectGrid.overlayTitleNoProviderFallback`, `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack` (app-shell), `fallback-placeholder-spelling-3512`, `ariaLabelLiteralCensus-12145` and `scripts/__tests__/defaults-population-parity-7904`. Result: `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 102 passed (102)`.
- ③ All exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:phantom-deps`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys` (every `createSafeTranslation` defaults row repeats its `en` value), `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources`.
- **Declared narrowing.** The full `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/components` suites and `pnpm lint` are left to CI. ESLint was run on the four changed TS files only, and that narrowing is a measurement:
  - `eslint.config.js` covers `**/*.{ts,tsx}`.
  - `--format json` reported 4 files and 0 errors, with warnings unchanged from BASE (`ObjectGrid.tsx` 207 = 207 and `groupedPagination.test.tsx` 2 = 2, read through `--stdin` on the BASE text). The two new files have 0 warnings.
  - The config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.

## Premise checks (on `origin/main` `c0c2f79`)

- `groupedPager` drew four icon-only Buttons with no `aria-label`: confirmed (the census's BASE reading names them).
- `table.firstPage` / `previousPage` / `nextPage` / `lastPage` are in the `table` block of all ten packs, so no pack key is needed. `GRID_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` is a module-local `const` that the `@object-ui/plugin-grid` entry does not export, so its four new rows add no public surface. Both facts that `Clause-②: no` rests on hold.
- `origin/main` moved to `faf4ce9` during this run. The one new commit touches no `Button`, so the frozen backlog still holds there.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **Server-grouped mode.** When a group spans more than one server page, `buildGroupTableSchema` gives that group's `data-table` its own pager, which carries the same four `table.*` names. A grid like that, which also has more than one page of groups, draws two buttons named "Next page". Not reproduced in a running app, so this is an observation only. Carrier: none.
- **Semantic overlap with in-flight work.** Any open PR that adds an unnamed icon-only `Button` under `packages/*/src` turns this census red after the merge-queue rebuild. That is the ratchet working as intended; the census's failure message gives the remedy.
- **Pending changeset `.changeset/12124-pager-button-names.md`.** It says the grouped pager is one "which this change does not name (objectui#12143)". That stays true of that change, and `check:changeset-claims` reports nothing to re-read.
